stimulus.question: Checkout is reported to show elevated errors in the OTel Demo. Using the authorized metrics range query and trace search for the last 5 minutes, determine whether checkout and its dependency calls (payment, product-catalog, cart, currency, shipping, email) show failures or elevated latency, cite trace ids, and return a json investigation report.

claims.text: Over 13:05:26-13:10:26 checkout produced 4.99 STATUS_CODE_ERROR span calls/5m versus 98.55 STATUS_CODE_UNSET, and payment produced 2.495 STATUS_CODE_ERROR versus 16.22 STATUS_CODE_UNSET; in the same window the only returned series for product-catalog (158.44), currency (24.95, STATUS_CODE_OK), shipping (23.70) and email (24.95) were non-error statuses, and cart's STATUS_CODE_ERROR series was 0 with 218.32 STATUS_CODE_UNSET.

Broken down by operation over the same 5 minutes, checkout's error spans are only oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder (2.495) and its client span oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge (2.495); payment's only error span series is grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge (2.495), while checkout oteldemo.CartService/EmptyCart, checkout oteldemo.CheckoutService/prepareOrderItems and cart POST /oteldemo.CartService/EmptyCart returned explicit ERROR values of 0.

In trace 593b276b114b189ad5a58a90c715f0ee the checkout span oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder (span_id 7aca521cb2b47968, 25729us) carries otel.status_code=ERROR and rpc.grpc.status_code=13 with description 'failed to charge card: could not charge the card: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold', and its child checkout client span oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge (span_id 32d30b5ce9f9ea6d, 15669us) carries rpc.grpc.status_code=2 with 'Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold'.

In the same trace the payment service's own server span grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge (span_id 303f8337b50463e4, 10075us) is ERROR with grpc.error_message 'Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold' and an exception stacktrace pointing at 'module.exports.charge (/usr/src/app/charge.js:37:13)'; the same trace also shows frontend-proxy ingress, frontend POST /api/checkout and frontend grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder spans with HTTP 500 / ERROR tags.

A second sampled failure trace, 265391257a3c3a331938a6fa0bdf3984, repeats the same pattern: checkout oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder (oteldemo.status_code ERROR, rpc.grpc.status_code 13) with message 'failed to charge card ... Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold', checkout client oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge (3297us observation: span_id 659e1b20032ddfae, 9297us) with rpc.grpc.status_code 2, and payment server span 7558328a40d79222 (3728us) in ERROR.

A concurrently sampled successful order, trace ecb5db586e9b1d2b27b9fcc318e27f11, shows checkout oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder 70430us with rpc.grpc.status_code 0, checkout client oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge 14797us with status 0, cart EmptyCart 7114us and GetCart 868us, shipping GetQuote 7428us and ShipOrder 601us, currency Convert 6320us, product-catalog GetProduct 591-892us, and email POST /send_order_confirmation 12864us with http.status_code 200 — i.e. the dependency chain also completed successfully within the same window.

Payment's Charge error share is not new to this 5-minute window: the per-5-minute ratio of ERROR to all grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge spans was 0 in the six buckets ending 11:45:26 through 12:10:26, then 1.0 (12:15:26), 0.8 (12:20:26), 0.25 (12:25:26), 0.818 (12:30:26), 0 (12:35:26), 1.0 (12:40:26), 0 (12:45:26), 0.714 (12:50:26), 0 (12:55:26), 0.75 (13:00:26), 0.2 (13:05:26) and 0.286 (13:10:26).

Over a 90-minute window ending 13:10:26 only three of the checked services returned any STATUS_CODE_ERROR span series: checkout 70.78, payment 35.39, cart 0; no ERROR series was returned for product-catalog, currency, shipping or email in that window.
